summary: Iteration 8 (YT-Music-style player panel bar, 'Made for you' daily mixes, Hinglish lyrics, cleaned Related, global mini-player, dismissible action sheet, fit-to-screen artwork) FULLY VERIFIED. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest passed (test_iteration8.py). GET /api/home/mixes?device_id=tester-cold returns 200 with day + mixes[]; cold device gets Discover Mix + language mixes (lang-hindi, lang-english); every mix has id/title/subtitle/color/covers[]/tracks[] with >=6 tracks. After seeding 5×2 recent plays + 1 favourite on tester-hist for arijit-singh search results, GET /api/home/mixes?refresh=true includes your-mix-N (subtitle names 'Arijit Singh'), discover-mix, and on-repeat. Library shows plays counts >=2 for the 5 recent tracks. Second call without refresh cached (<5s) with identical mix ids. GET /api/lyrics?title=Tum Hi Ho&artist=Arijit Singh&duration=262 returns synced+plain with NO Devanagari (regex [\u0900-\u097F]) and preserved [MM:SS.xx] timestamps; script=native returns 200 (content varies). 3 additional Hindi trending tracks verified: none contain Devanagari in default (latin) mode. GET /api/tracks/{barsaat-banjaare}/recommendations excludes seed id, excludes seed title (case-insensitive, brackets stripped), contains no Slowed/Reverb/Sped Up/Mashup/Lofi/Remix titles, and has no duplicate ids or normalized titles. FRONTEND (390x844 web, additional 360x740 for chrome check): Home shows 'Made for you' section with mix cards [mix-discover-mix, mix-lang-hindi, mix-lang-english]; tapping mix-discover-mix opens mix-screen with cover, subtitle, meta, mix-play/mix-shuffle/mix-download and track rows; tap mix-play → mini-player visible; mix-back returns to Home. Player screen (opened via mini-player) shows player-panel-bar with player-tab-upnext (badge=22 for upcoming queue), player-tab-lyrics, player-tab-related. Bottom row has Save (player-download-btn), EQ (player-eq-btn), Jam (player-jam-btn) with NO player-queue-btn or player-lyrics-btn (confirmed absent). Header has player-jam pill + player-more (⋯). At 360x740 the play button (72×72 @ y=515) and player-panel-bar (272×52 @ y=673) fit fully within 740px viewport; nothing clipped. Tapping player-tab-related slides up player-panel with queue-tabs (queue-tab-upnext/lyrics/related, Related active), Now Playing row, autoplay-switch card, 'Related to "<title>"' list with 15 suggest-play-*/suggest-add-* rows. queue-tab-upnext shows 'NEXT IN QUEUE · 22' with 24 queue-item-* rows (Now Playing + upcoming). queue-tab-lyrics renders lyrics-view with content ('maulaa mere, maulaa mere…') and NO Devanagari. queue-close hides panel (translateY=844 offscreen) and player-play-toggle is tappable again. Reopening via player-tab-upnext and tapping player-panel-scrim also hides the panel. Global mini-player: visible on Settings screen (via home-settings) after playback started; not shown on player screen (fullscreen route). Action sheet: tapping track-more-<id> shows action-play-next; tapping track-actions-dismiss removes action-play-next from DOM; reopening and tapping action-add-queue works. No red console errors after filtering pre-existing audio decode / shadow / autoplay warnings.

integration_issues.issue: Chromium HTMLAudio still can't decode JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 in web preview; not blocking on native.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /home/mixes (line 931-941): thin wrapper around _build_mixes with day-scoped cache in db.mixes_cache. Good design — cache key is {device_id, day}, refresh=true skips read but still upserts, so a same-day rebuild replaces the stored mixes and locks in identical ids on the next call (verified in test).

server.py _build_mixes (line 851-928): interest model correctly weights favourites (1.5x) and recency, gathers per-artist and per-language scores, and emits up to 7 mixes: artist-centred Your Mix 1..3 → Discover Mix → On Repeat (plays>=2, needs >=4) → Favourites Mix (favs>=3) → Language mixes. On the tester-hist seed (5 artist tracks × 2 plays + 1 fav) all three triggers fire and produced your-mix-1 with subtitle 'Arijit Singh and more', discover-mix, and on-repeat. Nice.

server.py /lyrics (line 645-653): script param defaults to 'latin' which calls romanize() on synced+plain — spec verified end-to-end. Only romanization when the source is non-null so instrumentals stay {'synced': null, 'plain': null}.

player.tsx (448 lines): artSize clamp on line 59 (max(180, min(winW-48, 360, winH-insets.top-bottom-470))) works — at 360x740 with 0 insets art shrinks to 270px, play button stays at y=515 and panel bar at y=673, fully inside 740. Panel bar (line 230-257) uses `flex:1` on each tab with a queueBadge on upnext showing upcoming count (verified 22 for a fresh queue). scrim + panel with pointerEvents toggled by tab state; no overlay-blocks-controls issue observed after queue-close.

player-panel.tsx (316 lines): tab={upnext|lyrics|related}, lyrics branch renders shared <LyricsView embedded /> (no ScrollView wrapper — LyricsView owns its own scroll). Upnext uses QueueList + moveInQueue/removeFromQueue/jumpTo. Related emits 15 suggest-play/-add/-more rows and an Autoplay card. Clean.

mix/[id].tsx (113 lines): FlatList ListHeaderComponent renders the mix header (cover + subtitle + meta + play/shuffle/download). On first mount with an empty useMixes() cache the header briefly waits for the fetched mix (`mix?.tracks.length` guard) before rendering the play buttons — this caused a 1–2s window in my test where mix-play query_selector returned null; a subsequent force click succeeded once tracks arrived, so functionally correct. Consider showing skeleton buttons during load if UX polish is desired.
track-actions.tsx (471 lines): the sheet backdrop Pressable already has testID='track-actions-dismiss' (line 129) that calls close(); verified panel closes and action-play-next leaves the DOM.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-8 surface (made-for-you row + mix screen + mix-play→mini-player, player panel bar with badge count, player-panel slide-up with tabs and 15 suggestions + 24 queue rows + Hinglish lyrics-view, queue-close and scrim dismiss both restore player controls, artwork fits at 360x740 with no clipping, global mini-player on Settings, action sheet dismiss via backdrop)

seed_data_creation: tester-cold and tester-hist library docs plus their mixes_cache entries were created during the test run. The conftest-style cleanup fixture in test_iteration8.py deletes db.libraries where device_id starts with 'tester-' and db.mixes_cache with the same prefix at teardown (module scope) — verified idempotent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-8 testIDs (new/changed): mix-<id> (Made-for-you cards on Home), mix-screen, mix-back, mix-play, mix-shuffle, mix-download; player-panel-bar (bottom bar), player-tab-upnext / player-tab-lyrics / player-tab-related (with badge on upnext when upcomingCount>0), player-panel-scrim (dimmed area above slide-up panel), player-panel (the slide-up sheet), queue-close (still exists inside the panel), player-download-btn / player-eq-btn / player-jam-btn (bottom action row on player). The queue is now presented as an in-player slide-up panel rather than a full-screen /queue modal — the file is still src/components/player-panel.tsx and testIDs queue-tab-* / suggest-* stayed the same. Global mini-player is injected by app/_layout.tsx GlobalMiniPlayer for any pathname not in FULLSCREEN_ROUTES (/player, /lyrics, /queue, /jam). Web audio decode still fails on JioSaavn AAC-in-mp4 (pre-existing) — mini-player becomes visible after playNow even though audio doesn't actually play in Chromium.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature-add pass. All spec items verified: (1) player panel bar with 3 tabs and upcoming badge is rendered by player.tsx lines 230-257, tapping opens PlayerPanel (src/components/player-panel.tsx) via animated translateY; (2) /api/home/mixes builds daily mixes from library.recent/favorites/plays and caches per (device_id, day) in db.mixes_cache — cold device gets Discover + language mixes, history device also gets Your Mix N (artist-named subtitle) and On Repeat; (3) /api/lyrics romanizes synced+plain to Latin by default and preserves timestamps — verified on Tum Hi Ho + 3 hindi trending; (4) /api/tracks/{id}/recommendations _is_variant filter suppresses Slowed/Reverb/Sped Up/Mashup/Lofi/Remix and dedupes by normalized title; (5) MiniPlayer is mounted globally in app/_layout.tsx and hidden on fullscreen routes; (6) track-actions.tsx line 129 backdrop Pressable already dismisses via testID track-actions-dismiss; (7) player.tsx line 59 clamps artSize to fit remaining vertical space so play button and panel bar stay visible at 360x740.
